challenges.instruction: Welcome to the candy counter! Can you make 7¢ for a sweet bubble gum using only pennies and nickels?
challenges.hint: Try using 1 nickel (5¢) and add some pennies (1¢) until you reach 7¢.

challenges.instruction: Yum! A fruity lollipop costs 15¢. Show me 15¢ using dimes and nickels.
challenges.hint: Start with 1 dime (10¢) and add a nickel (5¢) to make 15¢.

challenges.instruction: A chocolate chew costs 22¢. Let's make 22¢ using dimes, nickels, and pennies!
challenges.hint: Try using 2 dimes (20¢) and 2 pennies (2¢) to reach 22¢.

challenges.instruction: Look at this giant gummy bear! It costs 35¢. Can you make 35¢ using nickels and dimes?
challenges.hint: Try using 3 dimes (30¢) and 1 nickel (5¢), or count by tens and fives!

challenges.instruction: Time for the ultimate candy bag! It costs 60¢. Use quarters, dimes, and nickels to make 60¢.
challenges.hint: Start with 2 quarters (50¢) and add 1 dime (10¢) to get 60¢.

challenges.instruction: You are doing amazing! Buy the mega sweet box for 87¢ using all the coin types.
